Title: Ansible now available in Bash in Cloud Shell

Body.Content:
Ansible is now available—preinstalled and ready to use in Bash—in Azure Cloud Shell.

Ansible is an open-source product that automates cloud provisioning, configuration management, and application deployments. By using Ansible, you can provision virtual machines, containers, and cloud infrastructures. You can also use Ansible to automate the deployment and configuration of resources in your environment.

For more information, see the new Ansible documentation hub and try the Tutorial on running Ansible in Azure Cloud Shell.
